messages:
maria_runtime: heads up — after yesterday's kernel-selector rollout (PR #4123) we've seen host-side P99 tokenization+streaming latency go up ~18% on Dedicated nodes. Dash: https://dash.redwood/host/p99/999

ajay_ops: ugh. timeline? did the canary have the same bump? :thinking:

maria_runtime: canary was marginal, main rollout at 08:15 UTC. Spike aligns with canary -> progressive rollout to 40% -> jump at 40%.

lucas_perf: do we have flamegraphs or perf traces for the hot path? suspect writev/http2 framing + preparse.

maria_runtime: uploaded a perf snippet and a short flame:
```
# perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 30
# perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl > out.folded
# flamegraph.pl out.folded > flame.svg
```
Attached: flame.svg shows big slice in `tokenize_utf8` + `grpc::Writev` syscall cluster.

olivia_se: Also saw elevated KV cache misses around same window — KV hitrate drops 4% on ~long tail requests. Might be correlated if token boundaries differ now.

ajay_ops: can you post the small sample of logs for one affected request (headers + framing sizes)?

maria_runtime: sample log (redacted):
```
REQUEST_ID=abcd-1234
content-length: 0
:method: POST
:scheme: https
:authority: api.redwood
frame-sizes: [512, 1024, 128, 65536, 64]
parse-duration-ms: 2.9 -> 8.3
tokenize-duration-ms: 1.1 -> 6.4
writev-syscall-ms: 0.2 -> 3.7
```

lucas_perf: interesting — parse-duration jump looks like we started hitting a slower path in the tokenizer for mixed UTF8 + emoji runs. Kernel-selector also switched to the low-latency kernel at runtime which disables the optimized pre-token prefix merge. That would increase syscall counts.

ajay_ops: hypothesis: kernel selection decision toggles a code path that increases small writes (more writev calls) and prevents batching of parse fragments, which then increases KV cache churn because prefixes aren't coalesced.

maria_runtime: ran a quick bisect — reverting the kernel-selector commit in canary returns P99 to baseline within 10 minutes. I opened a rollback PR #4177.

olivia_se: good call. We should also add a unit/bench for mixed emoji sequences. This is a gap in our preflight.

lucas_perf: next steps I propose:
- rollback main rollout (if not already) -> done for canary via PR #4177
- add telemetry for per-request writev counts and tokenizer-path tag (low-latency vs throughput)
- add microbench for tokenization with emoji + combined scripts
- adjust kernel-selector heuristic to prefer prefix-coalesce when sequence entropy < threshold

ajay_ops: assign owners? lucas for perf traces + heuristic tweak, olivia for adding telemetry/bench, maria to coordinate rollback and deploybot checks. I'll monitor Dedicated SLOs.

maria_runtime: rolled back canary at 09:10 UTC and paused rollout. Filing a short postmortem and a follow-up canary after fixed heuristics.

deploy-bot: rollback applied to canary at 2026-03-23T09:10:34Z (deploy-id: dpl-7821). No errors.

olivia_se: I'll sketch the telemetry proto tonight and link a checklist. Also flagging docs to remind kernel-selector owners to add tokenization coverage to gating tests. :white_check_mark:

lucas_perf: I'll push a draft PR with a conservative change to the heuristic (prefer prefix-coalesce for request_size < 4KB or emoji_ratio < 0.1) and include microbench results.

ajay_ops: thanks. if we can get a canary by tomorrow morning with telemetry, we can validate quickly. Keep short cycle.

maria_runtime: updating the incident thread and scheduling a 15m sync at 10:00 to unblock. Thanks all. :rocket:
